reason: Both mechanisms in the r10 claim are closed at e01172e0, and they are the bd353501309f8cdd defect (fixed 0d9dfa62). (1) The struct literal is now unwritable outside the module: the fields are private (mcp-re-proxy/src/replay_plane/materialized.rs:50-63), a private unexported DurabilityWitness field is required (:44, :62), and accept is the only producer and always runs assert_durable (:97-104). backends is a sibling module (replay_plane/mod.rs:42-50). (2) The guard is now tested through the type, not only as a predicate: a_volatile_tier_under_a_linearizable_posture_cannot_be_built (:200-207). The r10 consequence scenario, a volatile store with fleet_strict:true and Linearizable, is also refused per request at http_profile_dispatch.rs:166-171.
missed_residue: The r10 row's own outside-packet question ('does the proxy accept an AsyncReplayTier by any route other than MaterializedReplay?') is answered yes, and the first pass names this only as 'outside the row'. HttpProfileProxy::new_delegated is a pub embedder constructor that takes any AsyncReplayTier plus a ProxyDispatchConfig with pub fields (http_profile_serve/mod.rs:255-263; http_profile_dispatch.rs:48-57). With fleet_strict:false, deployment_tier_admits returns Ok unconditionally (http_profile_dispatch.rs:69-72), so an embedder can serve a volatile tier. The only production caller is app.rs:468-473 (through materialize), so nothing here is attacker-reachable. It is a non-strict embedder posture, not this row's defect.

reason: BF-01 half: the early-returning function is gone. a_build_with_no_replay_backend_can_reach_no_replay_state is now #[cfg(not(any(redis_replay, cpstore_etcd)))] (materialized.rs:294-307), so a backend lane no longer reports it green, and the opposite property is a separate cpstore_etcd test (:335-345). Dispatch-assertion half: the fleet_strict/tier assertions (:242-250) run in //mcp-re-proxy:proxy_ext_unit_test, whose _PROXY_EXT_FEATURES include cpstore_etcd (BUILD.bazel:777-787, 1475-1477), so 'executes in no lane' is false. The tier/store coupling is also pinned in the default lane by a_plan_pairs_each_store_with_the_only_tier_that_store_serves (config_state/replay.rs:434-452).
missed_residue: The r10 fix recommendation ('split into per-lane #[cfg] tests rather than one function that silently changes meaning per lane') was applied to BF-01 only. a_backend_the_build_lacks_is_refused_and_named still branches on cfg!(cpstore_etcd) and cfg!(redis_replay) inside one function (materialized.rs:242-271), and its Redis arm asserts nothing in any lane that links redis_replay. The shipped flavor _PROXY_DEPLOY_FEATURES is redis_replay without cpstore_etcd (BUILD.bazel:794-799), and in that configuration no unit test asserts the Redis arm's dispatch posture (backends.rs:113-119). The first pass also says this residue is 'recorded under 63dd3c3d/74cf25ac', but those are open r10 twins of this same BF-01 claim (ledger loc replay_plane.rs:281), not records of the Redis-arm gap. They should be closed alongside this row, and the Redis-arm gap needs its own record if it is to be tracked.

reason: Vacuous-test half: composite_slots_are_injective now admits six distinct, boundary-shifted triples through one cache and asserts the signer slots pairwise distinct (mcp-re-http-profile/src/replay.rs:268-331). Separator half: the r10 attack needs signature_label taken off the wire, and it is not. The floor sets profile_id=PROFILE_TAG and signature_label=REQUEST_LABEL as constants (verify/floor/request.rs:140-141; ids.rs:21,25), and the only production HttpReplayKey copies them (dispatch.rs:182-188). With the first two join components constant, U+001F in actor_id (the last component) cannot shift a boundary anyway, and field_escape escapes it regardless (block.rs:95-97). This matches 4b5bdf05 (false-positive).
missed_residue: The first pass says the remaining type-level gap (HttpReplayKey has five pub String fields and is `pub use`d at mcp-re-http-profile/src/lib.rs:199; replay.rs:35-47) is 'tracked as b837e8c325e5fcb4 (fixed)'. That is wrong. b837e8c3 sealed ReplayKey (replay.rs:128-135), not HttpReplayKey. Because HttpReplayKey still has pub fields and to_replay_key (replay.rs:112-120) is ReplayKey's only constructor, any caller can still supply arbitrary signer and principal slots by hand-building an HttpReplayKey. 78aed5e44cea07c6 was closed as a duplicate of b837e8c3 on the same mistaken premise. No open ledger row covers it. It is low severity because the only producer is in-crate (dispatch.rs:182) and the inputs are not attacker-supplied, but the closure note should not credit a fixed row with it.

reason: A mismatched plan cannot be built any more. ReplayPlan's backend and tier are private (mcp-re-proxy/src/config_state/replay.rs:148-161), and ReplayState::materialization_plan (:117-131) is its only producer. git grep finds no other `ReplayPlan {` construction; test_support plans come from #[cfg(test)] config_state/mod.rs:294-295,435-443. That producer pairs Etcd with Linearizable and Redis with QuorumAcknowledged (:97-107). materialize reads plan.tier() and never re-pairs (materialized.rs:84-88), and backends copies that tier into the audit line and the dispatch config (backends.rs:44,59 / 88,117). The default-lane test is config_state/replay.rs:434-452. Redis always gets Some(wait_quorum_params), so the 'plain SET NX while advertising LINEARIZABLE' case is gone.

The serving path is fixed. materialize takes a FreshnessWindow (materialized.rs:76-80), whose only constructor refuses a skew outside 0..=MAX_CLOCK_SKEW_BOUND (config_state/freshness.rs:61-68), and AsyncReplayTier folds retention through it (async_replay/mod.rs:202). But the r10 row names three unvalidated constructors, and two of them are unchanged. SharedReplayCache::new(store, max_clock_skew_secs: i64) (shared_replay.rs:199, folded at :129-130,229) and InMemoryReplayCache::new(i64) (mcp-re-core/src/replay.rs:268, folded at :350) still take a raw i64 with no sign check. The first pass says they are 'only constructed by tests', and that holds for in-tree callers: every in-tree call is in a #[cfg(test)] module or a tests/ target. It does not settle the r10 claim, because both are published embedder API. mcp_re_proxy re-exports SharedReplayCache (lib.rs:369), and its crate doc advertises it for fleet serving (lib.rs:15: 'Fleet serving is supported: SharedReplayCache over an AtomicReplayStore gives cross-replica replay rejection'). mcp_re_core re-exports InMemoryReplayCache (core lib.rs:89). The sync dispatch entry is pub too (http_profile_dispatch.rs, pub mod at lib.rs:163). An embedder passing a negative skew gets retain_until < expires_at silently, which is exactly the r10 failure. The F4 ruling (owner-approvals-2026-10-04, replay-sync-stores-retired) deletes only the sync Redis/Etcd atomic stores, not SharedReplayCache or InMemoryReplayCache, so it does not absorb this.
missed_residue: Keep a residual open, rescoped to the public sync constructors SharedReplayCache::new (mcp-re-proxy/src/shared_replay.rs:199) and InMemoryReplayCache::new (mcp-re-core/src/replay.rs:268): either take FreshnessWindow or a validated skew, or refuse a negative one. Severity low or info, since there is no in-tree production caller. Also, the lib.rs:15 fleet-serving claim for SharedReplayCache is stale relative to async-is-the-architecture.

reason: This is the same two-part claim as 51a2fdd6. The test is rewritten with distinct, adversarial triples (mcp-re-http-profile/src/replay.rs:268-331). The lever this row names as realistic, signature_label taken from Signature-Input, does not exist. The label is the constant REQUEST_LABEL set by the floor (verify/floor/request.rs:141; ids.rs:25), and the only production HttpReplayKey copies it (dispatch.rs:184). profile_id is the constant PROFILE_TAG. Since the only non-constant component of the signer-slot join (actor_id) is last, U+001F there cannot create a cross-tuple collision, and field_escape escapes it as well (block.rs:95-97).
missed_residue: Part of the row's text is still literally true. 'No test exercises a component containing U+001F' still holds: the rewritten test shifts boundaries without SEP, and no test pins field_escape's .replace('\u{1F}', "%1F") (block.rs:97). Grepping the .rs files for the escape finds only the unrelated unescape test at bodyless/delegated_credential.rs:217, so deleting that line leaves every test green. Given constant profile/label it is not security-material, so this is an info-level test gap at most. The same HttpReplayKey pub-fields mis-attribution to b837e8c3 noted on 51a2fdd6 applies here.

reason: The serving path is fixed for both sign and equality. FreshnessWindow::new refuses a skew outside 0..=MAX_CLOCK_SKEW_BOUND (config_state/freshness.rs:61-68). The verifier and replay skews are one stored value (verifier_skew_secs :85-87, replay_retain_until :94-96). app.rs feeds the verifier from freshness().verifier_skew_secs() (app.rs:427,624,630,697) and the tier from the same window (app.rs:470 -> async_replay/mod.rs:202). However, the r10 row explicitly lists 'the same unchecked path' at SharedReplayCache::new (now shared_replay.rs:199), InMemoryReplayCache::new (now mcp-re-core/src/replay.rs:268) and skew_folded_retain_until (shared_replay.rs:129-131, saturating_add only). All three still accept any i64, including a negative one or one different from the verifier's. Both caches are pub re-exports (mcp-re-proxy lib.rs:369, advertised for fleet serving at lib.rs:15; mcp-re-core lib.rs:89). So 'no other path still reaching it' is false for an embedder, even though every in-tree construction is test code. F4 does not delete these types.
missed_residue: The open residual is the public sync constructors' raw-i64 skew: SharedReplayCache::new, InMemoryReplayCache::new and skew_folded_retain_until. It covers both the sign check and the verifier-equality check, since nothing ties these caches to a VerifierPolicy. Low severity: no in-tree production caller.

reason: 0522fe4a6ebdd8e0 is false-positive for the same reason the r10 row deferred to, the guarantees of ActorIdentity construction. The None arm still exists (mcp-re-http-profile/src/replay.rs:67-70), but the only production HttpReplayKey takes actor_id from ResolvedActor::actor_id -> ActorIdentity::actor_id (dispatch.rs:185; block.rs:195-197, 75-83). That always emits four ':'-joined components with ':' escaped to %3A (block.rs:95-96), pinned by actor_id_is_injective_across_colon_boundaries (block.rs:829-844). So rsplit_once(':') always returns Some at the keyid boundary. Every part of the r10 claim (silent fallback, per-key budget inflation) depends on a no-colon actor_id, which is unreachable. The rationale is the same, not just a neighbouring one.
missed_residue: The residue is only via HttpReplayKey's pub fields (replay.rs:35-47, re-exported lib.rs:199): a hand-built key with a colon-free actor_id still takes the silent fallback. No production producer does that.

reason: Untested half: the_principal_slot_is_the_subject_without_its_keyid (mcp-re-http-profile/src/replay.rs:338-362) and the exact principal-bytes assertion in the_replay_key_carries_the_same_injective_slots (:243-246) now cover principal_slot. This is 64eb59a7 (fixed). The ':' escaping the split depends on is pinned as a checked invariant by actor_id_is_injective_across_colon_boundaries (block.rs:829-844) and the golden at block.rs:813-826. The silent fallback (:67-70) is unreachable from the only production producer (dispatch.rs:185), which is the 0522fe4a adjudication. The r10 forward-looking risk ('becomes load-bearing once a budget consumes it') has materialized at async_replay/mod.rs:209-210, but it is guarded by the reachability argument and the new tests.

The client response timeout has headroom over the WAIT timeout. connect_pooled sets set_response_timeout(response_timeout_for(wait_quorum)) (mcp-re-proxy/src/async_redis_store.rs:161-163), which returns timeout_ms.saturating_add(WAIT_RESPONSE_HEADROOM_MS = 2_000) (:97, :217-223). The serving Redis arm reaches it through connect_with_wait_quorum(url, clock, tier.wait_quorum_params()) (backends.rs:104-110 -> async_redis_store.rs:140-146). The server's WAIT verdict is therefore authoritative at the boundary, as the r10 row asked.

The r10 row says explicitly 'No defect — this is a boundary statement'. It still holds. materialize (materialized.rs:76-90) constructs, guards via accept/assert_durable (:97-104, :127-138) and returns by value. It makes no admission call and retains nothing, and the replay_plane module owns nothing (replay_plane/mod.rs:9-18). The only production call is app.rs:468-473, and git grep finds no other non-test materialize call. Per-request admission lives elsewhere: replay_admission_stage -> dispatch_request_with_async_tier -> AsyncReplayTier::check_and_insert (http_profile_serve/answering_commitment.rs:44-58; http_profile_dispatch.rs:151-190). One nuance: assert_durable now takes an AsyncReplayTier (materialized.rs:127), so the row's wording that the sync InMemoryReplayCache/SharedReplayCache are 'the ones assert_durable refuses' is dated. They are not even of the type it checks. That strengthens the scope point and asserts no defect.

The r10 row says explicitly 'There is no attacker story; this is a scope statement'. It still holds. No check_and_insert is reachable from materialize (materialized.rs:76-104). The three facts the row says live elsewhere do: per-request admission is in replay_admission_stage (answering_commitment.rs:44-58), it runs after verification (it takes a VerifiedMcpRequest, http_profile_dispatch.rs:149-152), and the atomic stores are async_redis_store.rs and async_etcd_store.rs. Witness (a) is still two SharedReplayCache handles over one Arc-shared in-memory store (shared_replay.rs:657-672), single-process and not a serving type. Fact (b), refusal of a self-declared SingleProcessReference at materialization, still holds (materialized.rs:127-137).

The r10 row says explicitly 'No stale-capability defect is reachable today'. It records an implicit assumption, not a defect. The assumption still holds: the tier is materialized once (app.rs:468-473) and moved by value into HttpProfileProxy (http_profile_serve/mod.rs:186, 255-268). There is no Drop, epoch or reload seam for replay (replay_plane/mod.rs:9-18). git grep over mcp-re-proxy/src finds hot-reload only for CRL/TLS ServerConfig (config_snapshot.rs:114; tls_plane/crl_reload_worker) and none for replay. The skew is a Copy FreshnessWindow captured at construction (config_state/freshness.rs:44-51), and the ConnectionManager runtime binding plus DRAIN-BEFORE-RECLAIM are as described (replay_plane/mod.rs:20-40).
